Gathin23/cleanyourtv.title: CleanYourTV 3.3: hold OK to move your apps
Gathin23/cleanyourtv.body:
Your Home, in the order you want it. In v3.3, hold OK on any app on Home and a small menu opens: **Move**, **App info**, and **Remove from Home** when the App library is on. Choose Move, the arrows carry the tile, and Back puts it down. Until now this menu was a switch you had to find and turn on; in 3.3 every Home has it. The rest of this release is three days of the community at work: 47 more TVs, four new themes, Asturian in the launcher, and tools that tell you in a plain sentence when they can't reach your TV.

Since v3.2.0: **407 TV models** (from 360), **106 brands** (from 97), **31 languages** (from 30), **16 themes** (from 12), **177 projects in the showcase** (from 151), **262 pull requests from 163 people** in three days (v3.2 had 177 from 104 in two days). No binaries, as always: build the launcher with `launcher/build-and-install.sh`.

## Highlights
- **Hold OK to move your apps**: the tile menu is on by default. Hold OK on a Home tile for Move, Remove from Home (with the App library) and App info, and holding OK now opens it reliably (#2434)
- **47 more TVs from 9 new brands**: Bell Canada, DEXP, Hikeen, LYNCAST, Magyar Telekom, MarQ, Salora, TD Systems and TIM
- **Four new themes** (16 now): **minimal**, **blocky**, **storm** and **red-rain**
- **Asturian** in the launcher (#2460), so 31 languages, and the README in **Ukrainian** (#2675) and **Turkish** (#2858)
- **More switches for Home**: a 12- or 24-hour clock, Back for the clock screensaver, an app that opens when the screen comes on, and a remote button for the App library, all off by default
- **Safer on Android 14**: the core-package guard now covers the SDK sandbox, which fixes a TCL G08 that hung on the boot logo (#2557, #2696)
- **Tools that say what went wrong**: about 20 tools now stop with exit code 2 and a plain sentence when the TV can't be reached, instead of a traceback
- **Open on wake**, a new add-on (31 now) that opens the app you choose when the screen turns on (#2597)
- **177 projects in the showcase**, including StreamHome, Kids World and CleanYourTV Desktop

## Hold OK to move your apps
- **Hold OK on any tile on Home** and a small menu opens
- **Move** picks the tile up: the arrows carry it, Back puts it down
- **Remove from Home** (when the App library is on) takes the app off Home without uninstalling it; one press in the App library puts it back
- **App info** opens the app's own info page, which is what holding OK did before 3.3. It's still in the menu
- Holding OK opens the menu reliably, on every tile (#2434)

Prefer the old way? Put `"tile_menu": false` in your theme's `config.json`, and holding OK goes straight to App info again. Reorder apps under the Settings button still works too.

## Launcher 3.3
The tile menu is on by default (above). Everything else new is off by default; nothing changes unless a theme or config turns it on.
- **A 12- or 24-hour clock**, whatever the TV is set to (`clock_format`, #2271)
- **Back on Home opens the clock screensaver** (`back_opens_clock`, #2538)
- **Open on start, on wake too**: the Open on start app also opens when the screen comes on (`open_on_start_on_wake`, #2775). For any Home, there's the new **Open on wake** add-on (#2597)
- **A remote button for the App library**: `app_keys` takes the action word `library` (#2829), and Home runs `hold:` entries for vendor keys (#2419)
- **`input_action` can name an activity**, for TVs like the Redmi X65 whose inputs live in their own screen (#2573)
- **`glow_snap`**: the ambient glow changes colour in one frame instead of fading (#2896)
- **ColorOS TV**: the launcher declares the `MODERN_HOME` category that OPPO and OnePlus sets on ColorOS TV need before they boot a Home (#2080)

**Fixes**
- The glass highlight sits on the focused tile after a cold start, instead of an empty outline floating over the wallpaper (#2909)
- The focus glow stays level with a dock tile under `advanced_effects` (#2575)
- The compact header and date-below icons line up (#2713)
- A black backdrop sits behind Android 14's translucent Default home picker, so it's readable (#2780)
- The cinematic theme's "Last opened" line refreshes when Home comes back (#2328)
- Icon plates and card colours read multicoloured logos correctly, instead of treating them as grey (#2641)
- The VPN pill rests on dark glass, so its colour reads over a bright wallpaper (#2919)

## Themes
- **minimal**: a quiet look, close to Apple TV, made only from keys that already exist (#2807)
- **blocky**: 11 pixel-art scenes that follow the time of day (#2202)
- **storm**: four lightning photos, a new one every hour, behind a glass dock (#2531)
- **red-rain**: a red take on the Matrix digital rain (#2863)

Sixteen themes now. **Halloween stays** in `themes/halloween`: its skin switches itself off after 1 November, as planned, and the theme is still there to apply any time. [cleanyour.tv/halloween](https://cleanyour.tv/halloween) stays up too.

The theme tools run natively on Windows (#2674), `theme.sh` leaves `wallpapers/` to the launcher so pictures land on a fresh install (#2589), and `manage.py set` refuses a `--theme` folder that isn't there instead of making it (#2644).

## Add-ons (one new, in `addons/`)
- **Open on wake**: opens the app you choose when the screen turns on (#2597)

Smart Home gets a weather and fuel header (#2711), Weather's options can be changed with the remote (#1926), the News screensaver also asks for AUTO_START on TCL G08 builds (#2023), and Remote Access reports wireless debugging that runs with USB debugging off (#2451). Weather speaks Spanish (#2602) and Open on wake speaks Italian (#2931). Browse them all: **[cleanyour.tv/addons](https://cleanyour.tv/addons)**.

## New TVs and brands
47 more TV models, from 9 new brands: **Bell Canada** (Fibe TV, ARRIS VIP7802), **DEXP** (A651), **Hikeen**, **LYNCAST** (X3AQ), **Magyar Telekom** (TV box), **MarQ** (4K Android TV), **Salora** (SMART24TV), **TD Systems** (CH17F40S) and **TIM** (TIMVISION Box). Also new: the Sony XR-77A80L and XBR-75X850C, the Hisense U7 55U7SG, the Philips 77OLED810 and 65OLED807, two Fire TV Sticks (4K Max 2nd gen and 3rd gen), the Xiaomi Smart Projector L1 Pro, the XGIMI RS10 Ultra and Horizon 20, the Nokia R4, the BenQ QS02 stick and more. Plus second, third and even ninth units for many lists already here, and new device notes. The full list: [examples/](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv/blob/main/examples/README.md).

## Safety
- **The core-package guard covers the SDK sandbox**: a TCL G08 on Android 14 hung on the boot logo after it was disabled; the guard now keeps it (#2557, #2696)
- **`WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS` follows the switch**: an install without `RESTORE_KEY_SERVICES` now takes the permission back, instead of keeping it from an earlier install (#2458)
- **Safer lists**: the Insignia AFTDCT31 keeps Amazon Luna's player (#2904), and the Sony UR2 keeps Vewd, without which its AirPlay app crash-loops (#2737)

## Tools
- **`philips-api.py`** checks that the JointSpace API Home Assistant uses still works after a cleanup (#2688), and tells an unreachable TV from a disabled service (#2760, #2903)
- **Plain answers**: about 20 tools now stop with exit code 2 and a plain sentence when the TV can't be reached, instead of a traceback: `tv.py`, `trace.py`, `bench.py`, `b64push.py`, `privacy.py`, `manage.py`, `recovery.py`, `theme_restart.py` and more
- **Docker builds**: the image builds on a first run in Windows PowerShell 5.1 (#2893), and the Docker page explains why the build fails in an arm64 container on Apple Silicon and how to build natively there instead (#2895)
- `restore.sh` refuses a run with no list, or a flag it doesn't have (#2899); `b64push.py` leaves room for a long staging path (#2536, #2648); a screenshot cut off before its end is refused (#2620)
- `build-and-install.sh` finds the Android SDK under Homebrew in /usr/local (#2518)

## Translations
- **Asturian** in the launcher (#2460), so 31 languages
- The README now comes in **Ukrainian** (#2675) and **Turkish** (#2858) too, and the Italian README is up to date for 3.2 (#2548)
- Add-ons: Weather in Spanish (#2602), Open on wake in Italian (#2931)

## Showcase
**177 projects** (from 151), including **StreamHome** (#2927), **Kids World**, a home screen for children (#2882), a Chromecast Home fork with Up next and Now playing (#2898), **CleanYourTV Desktop** (#2662), **Art Frame** for the TCL NXTFRAME (#2576), **NoGmsVoice**, offline speech recognition for TVs without Google (#2577), the blocky cabin launcher and its Samsung Tizen port (#2607), and a Skyworth Coocaa port for Android 6.0 (#2824). See them all in [SHOWCASE.md](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv/blob/main/SHOWCASE.md).

## For contributors
- The launcher is about **573 KB** (from 561), under the 576 KB gate. versionName 3.3, versionCode 12
- New checks: a prebuilt binary is refused anywhere in the tree (#2709), every module card an add-on ships is one the launcher accepts (#2590), and every theme picture is a shape the launcher draws (#2601)

## Install and upgrade
- **New here**: send [PROMPT.md](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv/blob/main/PROMPT.md) to your AI assistant, or follow the README
- **Already on CleanYourTV**: pull the repo and run `launcher/build-and-install.sh` to upgrade to 3.3; your config and themes are kept. Holding OK on a tile now opens the tile menu; set `"tile_menu": false` in your theme's `config.json` to keep the old App info shortcut

June6699/dart_simple_live.body:
# Simple Live v1.13.2

发布日期：2026-10-01（2026-10-20 重新构建，版本号不变）

## 2026-10-22 追加改动

### Windows 安装包 [Discussion #147](https://github.com/June6699/dart_simple_live/discussions/147)，[PR #148](https://github.com/June6699/dart_simple_live/pull/148)，感谢 @821869798 

- Windows 端新增官方 Inno Setup 安装包 `SimpleLive-Windows-v1.13.2-Setup.exe`，与原有 zip 绿色版同时提供，按需选择。
- 普通用户免管理员权限即可安装到当前用户目录；以管理员身份运行时安装到 Program Files。
- 自动创建开始菜单快捷方式，桌面快捷方式为可选项；注册 App Paths，支持 `Win+R` 输入 `simplelive` 直接启动。
- 在系统「已安装的应用」中可正常卸载，自动清理安装目录与注册表项。
- 安装包采用 LZMA2 压缩（约 59.7 MB）；安装向导界面为英文。
- 构建侧顺带修复两处问题，保证 Windows 包可持续构建：libmpv 预编译归档被上游清理导致 CI 断流（升级至 20261021 构建，并增加主源 + 本项目镜像的多 URL）；抑制 VS 2022 17.12+ 的 MSVC 协程弃用警告，避免插件编译失败。


## 2026-10-19 追加改动

### 全屏方向可配置 [Discussion #141](https://github.com/June6699/dart_simple_live/discussions/141)

- 设置 → 直播间设置新增「全屏方向」：**智能（默认）** / **强制横屏** / **跟随系统**。
- 平板锁定竖屏时选择「强制横屏」，点全屏即可转成横屏铺满，不再只能接受竖屏里的信箱画面；退出全屏后回到系统锁定的方向。
- 「智能」下手机行为与旧版一致：全屏横屏直播自动横屏、退出回到竖屏、OEM 系统小窗内点全屏同样横屏、小窗展开后恢复沉浸式+横屏。
- 顺带修复：平板/大屏从系统小窗展开回全屏时，现在会恢复沉浸式（此前该分支与“能否锁方向”共用判断而被跳过）。
- 全屏方向按设备保存，不随配置包或账号同步迁移（手机与平板可以各自设置）。
- 平台限制：Android 16 及以上、屏幕最小宽度 ≥600dp 的设备，系统会忽略应用的强制方向请求，此时只能依赖系统自动旋转。

### 后台播放可关闭音频焦点 [Issue #144](https://github.com/June6699/dart_simple_live/issues/144)

- 设置 → 直播间设置新增「与其他应用同时播放」，**默认关闭**。
- 关闭时保持旧行为：后台播放/听直播会申请音频焦点，被前台视频应用抢占后按系统规范暂停。
- 开启后不再申请音频焦点，也不会在焦点丢失时暂停，可与 B站、微博 等应用同时出声；代价是可能出现两个应用同时出声，来电、蓝牙/车机等场景可能异常。

### 界面与入口修复

- 修复斗鱼「扫码登录」页面打不开的问题：页面依赖的 GetX 控制器没有随路由注入，点进去会直接抛异常退出。现改为在打开页面时绑定控制器，退出后自动释放。
- 修复扫码确认后换取播放 Cookie 失败（提示“斗鱼续期失败，请重新扫码登录”）：safeAuth 换票是**一跳 302 到 www 域后才下发 acf_* 登录 Cookie**，旧实现不跟随跳转、只读第一跳响应，因此必然拿不到 Cookie。现在按跳转链逐跳跟随并累积 Set-Cookie，每一跳都带上 LTP0/dy_did，换票结果同时兼容“只有 acf_* 没有 acf_jwt_token”的响应。
- 抖音直播间顶部信息改为两行：「在线」一行、「累计」一行；火焰/人形图标缩小，图标与文字间距收紧。站点名（如“抖音直播”）改为单行省略，不再与右侧在线数据互相压字。

### TV 端「我的关注」刷新体验[Issue #143](https://github.com/June6699/dart_simple_live/issues/143) 后续反馈

仅有 TV 端（`simple_live_tv_app`）代码改动，手机端行为不变：

- 刷新关注状态时列表保持静止，不再每次重排并整体重建关注网格；卡片「直播中 / 未开播」徽标仍实时更新，排序在刷新结束后统一生效。修复刷新期间首页光标在「我的关注」行与列表之间回弹、关注页多处同时点亮、左键弹出列表选不中，以及懒人模式读到刷新中间态顺序的问题。
- 关注卡片焦点节点改为按房间复用，重排或重建时焦点跟着卡片走；左键弹出列表打开时对在播列表拍快照，不再随刷新重建。
- 刷新续跑进度改为约 2 秒落盘一次，500 条以上任务的进度条改为每 20 条刷新一次，缓解大关注量（3000+）下的卡顿、闪退和自动刷新提前停止。
- 首页「我的关注」固定展示前 60 条，与关注页分页解耦。

> 说明：该批改动在 v1.13.2 安装包构建（10-19 17:56）之后完成，手机端安装包本来也不包含 TV 端代码，不影响本次手机端产物。TV 端需要重新构建 TV 安装包才会生效，详见 `release/tv_v1.8.2`。

### 文档

- `SETTINGS_GUIDE.md` 新增 9.6（平板锁定竖屏时不自动横屏如何设置）、9.7（后台听直播被其它应用打断的原因与开关），并更新了设置项说明。

## 新功能与平台支持

### 听直播模式（Android / iOS）

- 直播间菜单新增“听直播”，禁用视频轨并保留音频，降低耗电和流量。
- 独立音频页显示主播头像、名称与直播状态，提供播放/暂停及定时关闭。
- 支持 30、60、90、120 分钟或自定义时长；到时后按定时关闭逻辑退出。
- 加固后台收听：Android 使用前台服务，iOS 使用后台音频会话；主播下播、自动切换或刷新重连后仍保持纯音频状态。

### 斗鱼扫码登录与 Cookie 自动续期

- 账号管理中的斗鱼账号支持使用斗鱼 APP 扫码确认登录；手动 Cookie 配置继续保留。
- 本机保存续期凭据（LTP0 / dy_did），播放 Cookie 过期后自动向斗鱼 Passport 换取新 Cookie。Cookie 约 7 天的有效期不再要求用户定期手工更新；平台撤销授权或凭据失效时仍需重新登录。
- 扫码流程会提示用户：确认操作在斗鱼 APP 中完成，设备与位置信息由斗鱼侧记录；介意者可以改用手动 Cookie。
- 局域网设备同步和远程房间同步兼容传递续期凭据；旧接收端可忽略新字段，同步取得的 Cookie 也会尝试提取续期凭据。
- 斗鱼 WebSocket 播放地址按需使用 `expire=0`，降低短时效线路的断流风险。

## 修复与稳定性

### 斗鱼观看稳定性

- 播放恢复成功后重置连续失败计数，避免周期性断流几次后被误判下播。
- 斗鱼与虎牙线路耗尽后可重新签名取流再尝试；恢复过程中的取流异常进入既有兜底流程。
- 5 分钟内恢复超过 6 次时停止无限重试，按播放失败流程处理，并可按设置自动换台。
- 斗鱼登录态签名使用 Cookie 中的 `acf_did`；匿名态使用本机持久化的独立设备号。设备号不会随配置或账号同步迁移，Cookie 同步行为保持不变。

### 直播间进入与自动切换

- 进入被封禁或平台禁止进入的房间时显示错误页和手动重试入口；启用自动切换后，可继续检索正在直播的关注房间。
- 自动切换优先使用关注列表中的在播缓存并确认候选，避免逐一查询所有离线房间；遇到抖音 444 风控响应时停止本轮请求。
- 离线房间首次检索失败后，8 秒后补试一次；自动切换仍受跳转次数和时间窗口限制。

### 播放停滞与黑屏恢复

- 看门狗刷新纳入 5 分钟内最多 6 次的刷新保护；重复停滞时停止原地重刷并进入播放失败/自动切换兜底。
- 新增视频解码错误判据：30 秒内视频解码器错误达到 15 次时，交由恢复链重开播放。
- Android 前台播放期间额外观察 mpv 视频输出累计丢帧数。连续 3 个采样窗口各丢帧至少 25 帧时触发既有恢复链；每个窗口约 2 秒，短暂抖动、后台播放和用户暂停不会触发。该判据针对持续严重丢帧，不保证覆盖所有设备或解码器故障。
- Windows 最小化或完全遮挡期间按设置暂停播放，回到前台后恢复；后台播放错误延迟到前台处理，播放器打开操作设有超时，避免恢复链永久阻塞。
- Windows 停用视频尺寸异常自愈，避免回前台时与纹理管线恢复发生竞态。
- 修复 macOS（包括 Intel 设备）因 App Sandbox 限制媒体播放列表临时文件访问而导致所有线路播放失败的问题，并在启动播放器时检查临时目录可写性。问题与解码器选择无关。
- 修复定时关闭后立即重开应用时的播放器初始化闪退，以及退出期间错误写入“恢复上次直播间”状态的问题。

### 高弹幕房间性能

- 聊天列表使用独立响应式作用域，降低每条消息带来的页面重建开销。
- 弹幕消息按约 150ms 批量上屏；屏蔽、关键词过滤和去重仍逐条处理。
- 滚动弹幕轨道无可用位置时跳过无效排版，切房时先落盘上一房间的缓冲消息。

## 数据同步与抖音在线指标

- 局域网同步新增斗鱼账号发送入口，修复手机之间无法接收快手账号的问题。
- 远程房间同步支持哔哩哔哩、斗鱼、抖音和快手账号；默认服务地址为 `wss://june6699.top/sync`，自定义地址及备用线路不受影响。
- 抖音直播间分别显示**当前在线**和**累计观看**。弹幕消息的 `total` 作为当前在线，`totalUser` 作为累计观看；不会再与 HTTP 当前在线更新争写同一个数值位置。字段投票讨论见 [Discussion #139](https://github.com/June6699/dart_simple_live/discussions/139)。

## 参考来源

- 斗鱼 `safeAuth` Cookie 续期与 `expire=0` 处理参考 [SlotSun/dart_simple_live](https://github.com/SlotSun/dart_simple_live) v1.8.13（issue #182、#177）。
- 斗鱼扫码登录流程参考 [fancerest-png/dart_simple_live](https://github.com/fancerest-png/dart_simple_live) PR #190。后续加了一些修复，见前。

## 构建与验证记录

- 当前 v1.13.2 安装包构建于 2026-10-01，包含当日构建时的代码。
- 2026-10-01 已构建 Windows 与 Android（三种架构）；当时 `tools/build/verify_release_dir.ps1` 通过。

其他优化：清空本地数据不再因某一项失败而中断；AI 工具清理支持豆包；社交软件清理约快 3 倍。

darrylmorley/whatcable.title: v1.5.0: Devices in the right box, displays read from macOS, and live charging
darrylmorley/whatcable.body:
# Devices in the right box, displays read from macOS, and live charging

A big one. Ten betas went into this, and most of what changed started with a tester's report. Credits inline.

## Connected devices

- **Devices on a Thunderbolt chain show under a dock or display only when the hardware proves they are inside it.** Before, a device could look as if it sat in the first box in the chain just because nothing said otherwise. Anything unproven now appears under "Other USB devices on this port", and a dock's own hubs nest where they belong.
- **Thunderbolt 5 daisy chains are sorted.** On a Mac to display to dock chain, a drive in the dock used to render under the display. WhatCable now works out which box each hub belongs to from the fabric's own routing data, and leaves the tree alone if the answer does not check out.
- **Devices behind TB3-era docks and displays are attributed to a port again.** LG UltraFine 5K, CalDigit TS3+ and others of that generation bring their own USB controller, and everything behind them used to vanish as soon as two Thunderbolt things were connected.
- **Built-in USB-A ports are labelled and split per physical port** (#490, thanks @i0ntempest). The box now says to move those devices to a Thunderbolt port to see more about them.
- **A port that can't read cable details now says where to plug the cable instead:** a Thunderbolt port (#436, thanks @apple-ihack-geek).

## Displays

- The display check now reads what macOS says the display is doing, instead of estimating from bandwidth. It tells "the cable is limiting your monitor" apart from "your monitor is set below its best mode".
- Fewer false warnings on TVs and HDMI adapters: modes they can only send in reduced colour (4:2:0) no longer count against the cable.
- Every mode the display declares is read, including DisplayID blocks that were skipped before. Where macOS doesn't say enough, the card reads "Display connected" with the reason, rather than a guessed all-clear.
- The false "needs about 14.4 Gbps" warning on a monitor with a 75 Hz scan range is gone (#596, thanks @JarvisDong). Preferred refresh rates now count EDID borders, contributed by @YuriNachos.

## Thunderbolt

- **A Thunderbolt 5 link reads 80 Gb/s, not the per-lane 40** (#607, thanks @cannotcollide for the raw dumps). Asymmetric links show one rate per direction.
- An idle Thunderbolt port no longer reads as linked, and a stale row left after an unplug can't describe a link that isn't there.
- Another Mac on the far end of a Thunderbolt cable reads "Linked to another Mac" and no longer blames the cable.
- A charger-only cable no longer flashes "10 Gbps" as you plug it in (#181).

## Charging

- Charging state is now live: no more "charging on hold" for the first minute after plug-in, the open popover updates as it changes, and it now shows when your Mac is held at its charge limit.
- A third-party charger on MagSafe no longer shows Brick ID junk, and the card stops spinning on a non-PD charger (#592).
- Pro: the charging resistance estimate is visible and says what it is doing. Still labelled experimental.

## Cables

- **Straighter e-marker wording.** Some chargers and docks block the read, and the card now says so. While macOS is still reading it says "Reading cable details…", and when a charger negotiates above 3A without the Mac seeing the e-marker, it says what that contract shows. Thanks @jimmyorz (#413), @cannotcollide, @spreiter and @official-Cromatin (#578).
- **Cables with blank or partial e-marker IDs can be tracked**, and so can MagSafe 3 cables. Existing saved cables migrate automatically. Reported by @EmilEmilchen (#530).
- A registered power brick no longer softens a blank e-marker vendor ID, contributed by @YuriNachos.
- Apple accessories show their own names. Apple's USB-C EarPods read as a small powered accessory, not a 60 W cable (#542, thanks @maelcum).
- The cable database now holds 145 entries.

## Notifications

Thanks to @official-Cromatin for methodical reports and raw captures throughout (#550, #551, #556).

- Plugging in or unplugging a dock posts one notification naming the dock, with every device on its own row.
- Disconnect notifications say what left. Clicking a notification opens the popover. A disconnect replaces the held connect banner instead of piling under it.
- The phantom charger banner at launch is gone, and a device that drops and returns says "Reconnected".
- Thunderbolt gets named, and Pro users see a saved cable's name, including on charger notifications (#593).
- "Notify on app updates" is its own switch.

## The app

- **The port card groups every line under what told us it:** the cable's chip, your Mac's measurement, WhatCable's database, or the charger. Cards now settle once instead of assembling in front of you, and hold still while you read them (#536, thanks @miketuckman).
- **WhatCable takes up less room in the menu bar**, 36pt instead of 42pt.
- The popup no longer closes itself while you plug and unplug, follows the icon when you rearrange the menu bar (#543, thanks @maelcum), and closes when you tell it to.
- Settings has an Updates section with an "Include beta versions" switch.
- Numbers follow your region, and the app language setting reaches the menus too. Thanks to Rob for the number formatting.
- Pro screens and Settings no longer crop or float in window mode (#600, thanks @official-Cromatin).
- Pro: see and free your licence's device slots from Settings and the CLI.
- On a first run, the deep USB probe waits until the welcome screen has shown (#571, thanks @aapple1944 and @tvalleau).
- The desktop widget shows its detail line again, and a port no longer claims "Plugged in" when your Mac is on battery.
- The terms now say plainly that you can share what WhatCable tells you, as long as you describe it accurately.

## Test kit

- The test kit is rebuilt: it captures a fuller hardware snapshot in fewer steps, and uploads are smaller.
- The consent screen asks you to plug in what you want included and leave it connected until the run finishes, and names the Mac model identifier, which is sent with the run. Running it again no longer replaces your earlier submission.

## For scripts

- For scripts: `--json` and `--bench-report` display output has changed. `--bench-report` is now schema version 3, with every mode the monitor declares.
- For scripts: `--json` display objects gain new fields, and `compressionPlausible` is gone.
- New `whatcable --bench-report` command for a per-cable JSON capture.
- The terminal dashboard's power view no longer sits on "Waiting for telemetry..." on M1 Pro and similar Macs (#580, thanks @official-Cromatin).

## Update both together

If you use the standalone CLI, update it along with the app.

## Translations

Italian from @bovirus, Traditional Chinese from @jimmyorz, and Latvian from @shpokas.

## Thanks

To the beta group. @official-Cromatin reported and captured most of what changed in notifications and windows, @cannotcollide caught the Thunderbolt 5 speed and sent the dumps that fixed it, @maelcum stuck with the popout through several attempts, and @aldobalducci tested charging on beta.10. @YuriNachos contributed two fixes.

AnInsomniacy/rayburst.title: v4.1.1 — Aria2 Next 3.0.9 and Windows Fixes
AnInsomniacy/rayburst.body:
## What's Changed

This release bundles Aria2 Next 3.0.9 for all platforms. Downloads finish without a slow tail, a retried download no longer corrupts its file, and a slow IPv6 route no longer holds a download back. It also fixes the Windows installer and caption buttons, external links, repeated clipboard prompts and RPM upgrades from a beta.

### 🛠 Improvements

- **Aria2 Next 3.0.9** — a slow connection hands its remaining range to idle ones at the end of a download (#762); connections move off an address family that is several times slower, so a broken IPv6 route no longer keeps a download at a crawl; connections that fall far behind are replaced
- **Clipboard** — a copied link is offered once per run, also after the main window is recreated from the tray or the link was already used in the add window (#751)
- **Browser takeover** — when the engine receives a verification page instead of the file, Rayburst takes over from the address the browser actually landed on (rayburst-connect#104)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed corrupted downloads after a retry: the unwritten part of a preallocated file is no longer counted as downloaded, and a server that rejects extra connections with 403 lowers the connection count instead of failing (#767)
- Fixed the Windows installer failing to stop running processes (#756)
- Fixed the caption buttons not reacting to hover or clicks on Windows 10 (#755)
- Fixed links in the update notes opening inside the app; links that leave the app open in the system browser (#764)
- Fixed a window hidden to the tray reappearing when the GNOME session locks (#759)
- Fixed a paused multi-file torrent asking for its file selection again (#754)
- Fixed RPM upgrades from a beta to the stable release being refused as a downgrade (#766)

Devolutions/UniGetUI.title: UniGetUI v2026.3.3
Devolutions/UniGetUI.body:
# Devolutions UniGetUI 2026.3.3

This release lets you add your own installers to the Software Catalog, adds Extensions starting with Git Repositories, lets you choose package list columns by right-clicking the header, and asks for confirmation before uninstalling or ignoring several packages. It also fixes many WinGet, PowerShell and Scoop update bugs.

### New Features
* The Software Catalog can now offer installers: .exe and .msi on Windows, and .pkg, .dmg and .zip on macOS. They are served from a shared folder or a web folder and can be installed, updated and uninstalled like any other package
* The Catalog Editor is now hidden behind its own setting, under Settings > Experimental
* Added Extensions in Settings, starting with Git Repositories. It keeps your local Git clones up to date on their default branch and shows their worktrees and branches. Extensions are off by default.
* You can now choose which columns a package list shows by right-clicking its header. Changes apply right away.
* Added an optional Release date column to package lists.
* You can update an ignored package once from **Manage ignored updates**, and it stays ignored afterwards.
* Scoop can now install a specific version.
* Added a Release notes item to the right-click menu on Software Updates.
* `unigetui://package` links now open a package's details.
* You can now hide the tray icon while UniGetUI keeps running in the background.
* Added an option to quit UniGetUI once automatic updates have finished.

### Improvements
* UniGetUI now asks for confirmation before uninstalling packages, and before ignoring updates for several packages at once.
* On first launch, package managers whose tool isn't installed are now turned off, and pages say when no package manager is available instead of reporting that everything is up to date.
* Cargo no longer needs `cargo-binstall` or `cargo-update`.
* `update-all` and `update-manager` commands now work in headless mode.
* In-app dialogs now close when you click the dimmed area around them.
* Toolbar buttons are disabled when they have nothing to act on.
* The operations panel now counts failed operations separately.
* The search settings in the filter pane are grouped into one collapsed **Search options** section.
* On macOS, the menu bar icon now matches the menu bar's color, and the window buttons sit inside the glass sidebar.
* Improved Tab and Shift+Tab navigation in tabbed pages.

### Bug Fixes
* Fixed Bun packages not being listed when Bun uses a custom install folder.
* Fixed logging out or shutting down on Linux being blocked by UniGetUI.
* Fixed long translated labels being cut off on the package details action button.
* Fixed npm not being found on macOS when it is installed through nvm.
* Fixed operations that need administrator rights failing in headless mode.
* Fixed Store and MSIX apps showing names like `ms-resource:AppStoreName`.
* Fixed the Close button stopping short of the window's right edge.
* Fixed the swapped package counts in the page subtitle.
* Fixed updates not appearing for packages with very large version numbers, such as Scoop nightly builds.
* Fixed updates running even when an app listed under "Close apps before installing" couldn't be closed.

Thank you to everyone who reported issues and contributed improvements to the project.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/Devolutions/UniGetUI/compare/v2026.3.2...v2026.3.3

byJoey/cfnew.title: CFnew 精简内核 2026.10.17.2
byJoey/cfnew.body:
# CFnew 精简内核 2026.10.17.2

这是 **精简内核版**，来自默认分支 `core-only`。旧完整版仍在 `main`，旧版下载保留在 [v3.1](https://github.com/byJoey/cfnew/releases/tag/v3.1)。

**[部署和迁移说明](https://github.com/byJoey/cfnew/blob/core-only/README.md) · [完整变量表](https://github.com/byJoey/cfnew/blob/core-only/docs/variables.md) · [视频教程](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EfhHV62CuEU&t=2s) · [打开面板](https://cfnew.xy.kg/)**

## 下载哪个文件

Windows、macOS、Linux 都用同一份，按 Cloudflare 部署方式选择。

| 文件 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `Pages.zip` | Cloudflare Pages 直接上传。包根目录只有 `_worker.js`，不用解压。 |
| `_worker.js` | Cloudflare Workers 编辑器中完整替换代码，保留 ES Module 格式。 |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | 上述两份文件的 SHA-256 校验值。 |

GitHub 自动附带的 `Source code` 是整个源码仓库，不能直接作为 Pages 部署包。仓库的 `pages.zip` 与本发行的 `Pages.zip` 字节一致。

## 内核与面板

- 核心 **37,806 字节**，负责代理转发、DNS 转发与 KV 配置接口。
- 管理页面、优选列表处理、在线检测和订阅生成由独立面板提供。
- 保留 VLESS WS、Trojan WS、VLESS XHTTP（HTTP/2、`stream-one`），支持 SOCKS5 / HTTP / HTTPS 出站。精简内核不提供 Shadowsocks 入站与通用 UDP 转发。
- 节点流量仍直接连接自己的 Worker，不经过面板服务器。独立面板源码见 [cfnew-panel](https://github.com/byJoey/cfnew-panel)。

## 本版新增：Free CPU 保护

- 默认关闭，可在面板开启并保存，或设置 Worker 变量 `freeCpu=yes` / `FREE_CPU=yes`。KV 配置优先，对新连接生效。
- 上下载共用 **384 KiB / 96 个数据块**预算，超出任一项就主动断开；新连接重新计算，保留原 WS / XHTTP 协议。
- 减少重复鉴权计算与不必要拷贝。预算经过边缘测试校准，但 Worker 没有实时 CPU 余量接口，**不保证免费账号零超限**。
- 当前下载、视频或长连接可能中断，客户端需要自行重连，不保证自动续传。旧核心需更新后才能使用开关。

本次正式发行还补齐了部署步骤、全部配置字段和别名、配置优先级、API、旧版迁移与文件校验说明；代理核心与已发布的 `2026.10.17.2` 版本一致。

## 部署

1. Pages 上传 `Pages.zip`，或 Workers 粘贴 `_worker.js` 完整代码并部署。
2. 添加文本变量 **`u`**，填自己的 UUID；大写 `U` 也支持。
3. 需要在线保存设置时，绑定自己的 KV，名称填 **`C` 或 `c`**。只添加同名文本变量不能代替 KV 绑定。
4. 兼容日期设置为 **`2026-01-20`**，更改变量、绑定或日期后重新部署。Pages 请确认设置在生产环境。
5. 绑定可用域名，打开 [面板](https://cfnew.xy.kg/)，填写域名和 UUID，也可使用 `d` 设置的自定义路径登录。
6. 保存配置并复制面板生成的订阅到客户端。未绑定 KV 仍可生成订阅，不能在线保存。

Worker 首页显示 `hello` 是正常现象。面板与内核版本一致时不显示升级提示。

## 旧版迁移与回退

- 升级前备份原代码，保留原 UUID、KV 绑定和域名；上传新版不会主动清空 KV。
- **旧 Worker `/UUID/sub` / `/sub` 地址需要换成面板生成的新订阅。** 不能只更新代码、继续沿用旧订阅地址。
- XHTTP 请用 `stream-one`，不要改成 `packet-up` 或 `stream-up`。sing-box 使用 1.12 及以上版本。
- Surge 用户需开启 `et=yes`，当前该格式只输出 Trojan。Clash / sing-box / Loon / QuanX 的 VLESS 节点使用 WS，请保留 `ev=yes`；实际 XHTTP 使用支持它的客户端导入 Base64 / VLESS 分享链接。
- 环境变量修改后若不生效，检查 KV 是否保存了同名配置；优先级是 KV > 环境变量 > 默认值。
- 需要回退时重新上传备份的旧版代码，保留原绑定，并恢复对应版本的订阅入口。

## 校验文件

macOS：

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS.txt
```

Linux：

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt
```

Windows PowerShell：

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Pages.zip -Algorithm SHA256
Get-FileHash .\_worker.js -Algorithm SHA256
```

Windows 将输出与 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 中对应文件的值比较即可。

Please note that the wizard worker gets deployed only from [Wizard Github repository](https://github.com/bia-pain-bache/BPB-Wizard/tree/dev) directly for your safety.
Wizard gives you a PRIVATE LINK after first installation and this link is a ONE-CLICK wizard.
Also manual deployment and BPB Wizard client deployments do not work on this release.

## 💡 Improvements

- An admin dashboard is added to panel in order to monitor your request usage, UPDATE panel to the latest version, permanently DELETE panel, reset password and set Telegram Bot.
- UPDATE panel checks latest releases in background and gets enabled whenever there's a new stable release.
- Telegram Bot is now implemented, you can get subscriptions, single configs and monitor your account request usage. It also warns about usage by passing 80% threshold, PR #1313
- Now you can add Custom Domain to your panel from `Common` settings, dashboard setup is no longer needed. Also Custom Domain configs will be merged into your subscriptions with `D` tag so you don't need to login panel with domain and get another subscription.
- All fixed variables like `VLESS UUID`, `Trojan Password`, `Subscription - Panel path`, `DoH URL`, `Proxy IPs`, `Nat64 Prefixes`, `Fallback` domain... can now be updated from panel. There's no Environment Variables in your Cloudflare dashboard anymore.

> [!TIP]
> BPB is not using Cloudflare D1 for this fixed variables due to D1 delay overhead and another infrastrucure inconsistencies. All of them are hardcoded into script.

- Panel login now requires your `Cloudflare Email` as username. This will address security concerns like #1348
- All Panel, Subscriptions and related URLs are ceiled by a compulsory `SECURE PATH` to maintain more security.

> [!CAUTION]
> You cannot reach your panel by just adding /panel to your worker domain anymore. The new entry is like https://xxxx.workers.dev/SECURE_PATH/panel, which the path is a random generated secure path by wizard. You can change it in panel later if you wish, panel will redirect you to new URL.
> So please don't forget to save your panel URL after online wizard finished the job.

- `Underlying DoH` is added to common settings which is used as your panel `DNS over HTTPS` underlying server.
- `Fallback` behaviour is now throwing 404 by default. You can set `Fallback Domain` in Common settings section.
- single `Proxy IP test` is added to related page.
- Updating panel settings from a Remote BPB Panel and sharing settings is added in addition to existing File import and export. You can share or get all of settings except `VLESS UUID`, `Trojan Pass`, `Panel Path` and `Custom Domain` with some another BPB user.
- Updated Clash, Amnezia Warp Pro settings. This may help connection on some ISPs.
- Chain Proxy now supports `Xhttp` and `VLESS Encryption` for Xray and Clash cores.
- Made Warp `Reserved bytes` optional. Some ISPs flagged reserved bytes.
- Optimized Warp Pro noise generation for Xray core.
- The Panel UI has been improved a lot and removed dark/light mode.
- `Supported Clients` section added to Panel and Telegram including download latest version from sources.
- Solid Data validations execute in backend from now on.
- Implemented Toasts and message boxes instead of alerts in panel.
- The whole project is restructured for maintainability purposes.
- Updated default Warp accounts.
- Fixed Typos in doc #1349
- Fixed HTML embedings in script #1344
- And lots of another subtle bug fixes and improvements...

## 💡 Changes since 5.0.0

- API Token has been changed and v5.0.0 Private Links and old tokens won't work on this.
- Added `Import - Export` section to panel with ability to update settings from another BPB panels #1329
- Added `Xhttp` transport and `VLESS Encryption` support to Chain Proxies for Xray and Clash.
- Updated `Amnezia` H1-H4 params #1353
- Made Warp `Reserved bytes` optional #1236
- Resetting Telegram webhook after changing panel path.
- Changed panel update check endpoint.
- Panel UI improvement, added `Supported Clients` section to Panel and Telegram with download links.
- Encapsulated worker domain and Custom Domain configs into separate URL tests #1359
- Implemented built-in QR code generation for Telegram and panel.
- Renamed configs filenames and sync Telegram and panel downloads.
- Fixed sing-box qrcode and subscriptions.
- Fixed Trojan password validation.
- Fixed Chain Proxy validation #1352
- Fixed missing sing-box Upstream Proxy #1354
- Some other bug fixes.

ZCShou/GoGoGo.body:
本次更新重点提升模拟定位的兼容性、稳定性和操作体验。

## 新增功能
- 新增“圆形摇杆”和“按钮摇杆”两种控制样式，可在移动设置中切换。
- 支持向 GPS、网络和融合定位 Provider 同步提交模拟位置，提升应用兼容性。
- 消息已读状态支持版本跟踪，公告或客服消息更新后会重新显示为未读。
体验优化
- 统一使用 WGS-84 坐标存储和处理，改善地图搜索、坐标输入、历史记录及路线坐标的一致性。
- 优化模拟定位服务生命周期，减少真实位置与模拟位置之间的回跳。
- 模拟位置提交失败时自动尝试恢复定位 Provider。
- 优化位置更新节奏和运行时权限检查，提升连续模拟的稳定性。
- 统一操作结果提示样式，使成功和错误提示更加清晰。
- 优化摇杆锁定、拖动和路线控制交互。
## 问题修复
- 修复轻触圆形摇杆时控制点发生意外移动的问题。
- 修复部分使用融合定位的应用无法及时获取模拟位置的问题。
- 修复消息回复或内容更新后仍显示为已读的问题。
- 修复部分页面生命周期切换后位置显示不同步的问题。
- 增强运行环境与敏感路径检查。
## 升级提示
由于坐标存储结构升级，从 2.0.2 升级至 2.1.0 时会重建本地数据库，本机保存的以下内容将被清除：
- 位置历史
- 路线历史
- 地图搜索历史
账号、会员及其他服务端数据不受影响。

agalwood/Motrix.title: v2.2.1
agalwood/Motrix.body:
# Motrix 2.2.1

English | [简体中文](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/v2.2.1/docs/release-notes/2.2.1.zh-CN.md)

Motrix 2.2.1 fixes startup recovery for broken magnet sessions and HTTP retries
that previously lost their original request context or download progress.

## Changes since 2.2.0

- Keep a magnet task with missing torrent metadata or a deleted download directory
  from blocking engine startup. Recover from hash-verified application metadata
  where possible; otherwise, back up the engine database and retain the affected
  task as a removable error. Healthy tasks can start, repeated launches do not
  recreate deleted directories, and unrelated task history is preserved. Also
  prevent verified old metadata history from reappearing as an extra HTTP task.
- Retry eligible failed HTTP downloads using the original task, engine GID,
  output path, request options, cookies and checkpoint. Retain the required engine
  context across restarts, including explicitly empty cookie jars. The engine
  checks the original resource identity before reusing partial data; credentials
  stay in the engine and are not copied into application task records. Restored
  failures still require an explicit Retry. Alt+Retry keeps the form for editing
  a new download request.
- Discard pending Retry availability responses after Web UI logout,
  reauthentication, or loss of connection readiness, so an old response cannot
  reopen a cleared dialog or dispatch a previous retry request.
- Update the packaged engine to **aria2 1.37.0-motrix.22**, including the HTTP
  continuation contract and stricter handling of malformed torrent piece lengths
  and empty input-file lines. Native packaging checks exercise real-engine
  continuation and session recovery on all six desktop targets.
- Carry forward the Snap publication recovery fixes: verify and reuse accepted
  package hashes, preserve each architecture’s revision independently, and
  release only the complete verified build set.

Electron remains **45.2.1** and `vscode-jsonrpc` remains **9.0.3**.

## Upgrade and retry compatibility

**Back up your profile and download files before upgrading.** The new engine
upgrades its SQLite database to **schema 6**, preserving a complete pre-upgrade
backup, including committed WAL data. Older engines cannot open schema 6. If a
downgrade is necessary, stop all engines and restore a verified pre-upgrade backup
to a separate path; do not delete or reset the upgraded database. Keep backups
from earlier upgrades as well.

Original-task HTTP continuation requires SQLite persistence, a supporting engine,
and historical request/resource context captured for that task. Previously deleted
cookies or missing historical validators cannot be reconstructed. Older tasks and
custom engines without the required capability may still use the existing
fresh-download parameter form. Changed or unverifiable resources are not silently
resumed with old partial bytes. This release does not claim to resolve every
site-specific authentication failure; [#2426](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/issues/2426)
and [#2488](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/issues/2488) remain open for user verification.

Users migrating from Motrix v1 should follow the
[migration guide](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/v2.2.1/docs/legacy-migration.md)
and retain the original profile and engine database backups.

## Downloads and updates

Desktop packages support macOS 13 or later, Windows 10 or later, and Linux, with
native x64 and ARM64 builds. No 32-bit desktop packages are provided. Official
macOS packages require signing and notarization. Windows NSIS installers and ZIP
archives are unsigned and may trigger SmartScreen; use official Release downloads.

Stable publication updates both `latest*.yml` and `beta*.yml` feeds to 2.2.1.
Flatpak bundles and Native Host companions remain separate downloads. Snap
availability requires verified Store publication to edge and promotion of the
same amd64/arm64 revisions through candidate to stable.

Server images use `docker.io/motrixapp/motrix-server:2.2.1` and
`ghcr.io/agalwood/motrix-server:2.2.1`. After public multi-platform runtime
verification, `2.2`, `2`, `stable`, and `latest` advance to the same verified digest.
See the [Docker Server guide](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/blob/v2.2.1/docs/docker-server.md).

[Full changelog](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/compare/v2.2.0...v2.2.1)


## What's Changed
* ci(snap): recover uploads from verified tag artifacts by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2483
* fix(snap): initialize the store client with persistent auth by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2484
* fix(snap): isolate publication architecture from snap runtime by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2485
* fix(engine): isolate unrecoverable magnet sessions on startup by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2486
* fix(downloads): continue retained http tasks through the engine by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2489
* fix(downloads): discard retry queries after session changes by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2490
* fix(engine): bundle aria2 motrix.22 with safe session recovery by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2491
* chore(release): prepare 2.2.1 by @agalwood in https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/pull/2493


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix/compare/v2.2.0...v2.2.1

cloud-fs/cloud-fs.github.io.title: v1.1.3
cloud-fs/cloud-fs.github.io.body:
CloudDrive2 Core V1.1.3(Web3.1.3)

1. SMB 存储的共享名称可以留空(#630)。 留空时添加的是整台服务器，服务器上的每个共享显示为一个文件夹，不包括 IPC$、C$、ADMIN$ 等管理共享。共享本身不能删除或重命名，也不能在共享这一层新建文件夹或上传文件；不同共享之间不能直接移动文件。填写了共享名称的存储与以前相同。网页版添加 SMB 存储时，共享列表中新增"全部共享（每个共享显示为一个文件夹）"选项，点击"发现共享"后不再自动选中第一个共享
2. 修复从部分 NAS 通过 SMB 复制或读取文件时停在 0 B 的问题(#619)。 一次读取的数据量超过服务器允许的大小时，现在分成多次读取。SMB 存储中设置的端口以前不生效，总是使用 445，现在使用设置的端口
3. 修复复制或上传时个别文件一直显示"预处理中"，所有传输停止，只有重启服务才能恢复的问题(#634)。 预处理连续 30 分钟没有进展时，会结束并自动重试；对一直显示"预处理中"的项目暂停再恢复，会重新开始预处理
4. 修复 123 云盘等 WebDAV 存储挂载一段时间后，部分文件一直下载失败（403 Forbidden），只有删除后重新添加才能恢复的问题(#627)。 WebDAV 服务器给出的下载链接最多使用 10 分钟；下载失败时，会重新向服务器获取链接
5. 修复添加 S3 存储时选择"不要将这些设置同步到云端"不生效的问题(#629)。 以前 S3 存储总是同步到其他设备。已经同步的 S3 存储，需要删除后重新添加，并选择这个选项
6. 修复 S3 存储经过开启了 HTTP/2 的 NGINX（1.26 及更早版本）或雷池 WAF 反向代理时，返回 400 Bad Request 的问题(#629)。 S3 请求失败时，错误信息中会显示具体原因
7. 修复添加 CloudDrive 存储（连接另一台 CloudDrive2）时，允许不安全的 TLS（跳过证书验证）后，连接使用部分类型证书的服务器仍然失败的问题(#631)。 连接失败时，错误信息中会显示具体原因，不再只显示 "transport error"
8. 修复通过远程上传接口再次上传同一个文件时，收不到任何消息、上传不会开始的问题(#633)。 现在会替换之前的上传任务，之前的上传会收到"已取消"状态
9. 修复阿里云盘开放平台的访问令牌失效时，短时间内反复刷新令牌的问题。 现在服务器拒绝访问令牌时刷新令牌，连续刷新两次仍被拒绝则不再重试

说明：

- 修复在歌词页进入全屏后离开歌词页，窗口会卡在全屏状态、只能按 F11 退出的问题，感谢 [@xianshi3](https://github.com/xianshi3)（#2483）

- 网页版：修复部署到 Netlify 后直接访问子页面出现 404 的问题，感谢 [@LittleChest](https://github.com/LittleChest)（#2467）

### 🔧 其他

- 设置页「缓存」标题补上多语言翻译，感谢 [@yottanami](https://github.com/yottanami)（#2488）

感谢本版本的所有贡献者，其中 12 位是首次参与贡献！
